result:
I added the plan for what is left of `check/` and `emit/` to `docs/selfhosting-plan.md` and pushed it to `develop` as commit 11e85bfa. Nothing was built. The guard set passed (22 tests), and so did `scripts/pre-push-check.sh`.

The new section, *C-7 rest and E12: what is left*, finds about 2,450 of the 5,883 Rust lines movable, in five slices, listed in build order:

| Slice | What moves | Waits for | Rust lines |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: |
| C7-r1 | the two claim refusals, the state `walked` builds from the item list, `payload_of`, `place_of`, `Mark`/`mark_of`; deletes dead code | nothing | ~420 |
| E12-1 | `with_contracts`' item tables, `Needs`, `abort_table`, `split_lifetimes`, `inline_written` | nothing (`Ledger` is already Nikaia) | ~470 |
| E12-2 | the template-hole tables, `fold_callees`, `built_at_build_time`, `names_read` | R-6, or a probe that the Nikaia walkers visit the same nodes | ~350 |
| E12-3 | the seeds reader and the host's `seeds_begin`/`seeds_end` | one `Shape` type: `contracts/maps.rs` has a Rust copy of the one in `ty.nika` | ~560 |
| E12-4 | `Target`, `Build` and the related enums, plus `rust_targets.rs` | a probe that the lowering derives `Copy`/`Default`/`PartialEq` | ~700 |

- **What stays Rust:** the entry points, building `CheckWorld`, the calls to the Rust analyses in `walked` and `with_contracts`, `dump_accepted`, the crossing machinery and `OutText`. Each has a one-line reason in the section.
- **First slice to brief:** C7-r1. It needs nothing, and C7-r1 and E12-1 touch different files, so they can run in parallel. Each slice's main risk is noted in the section.
- **Dead code found:** in `check/mod.rs`, `a_byte`, `byte_literal`, `an_or_a`, `boxed_member` and `ASSERT` have no callers. There are also two empty `impl Checker<'_> {}` blocks with orphaned doc comments above them. C7-r1 deletes them.

The project-test cache is 3.5 GB and the disk has 19 GB free. One new entry over 100 MB, `run-bundle/65d964130cc06fb2` (293 MB), is not from this run, since I ran no project tests.

done 11e85bfa, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/c7-rest-plan.md.report.md
